name: Transok West-to-East Expansion
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 31: Transok West-to-East Expansion, operator Transok Pipeline Co, New Pipeline, Completed 1997-04, Oklahoma intrastate (State authority), 130 mi, 24 in, 255 MMcf/d added, cost 75 (millions) so 75000000 USD. url_verifier OK with --name. Single source, one EIA origin; no independent second found. The OGJ article of 12 Feb 1990 (verified) describes Transok's earlier 63 mi 24 in Wilburton to Texoma extension and a 23.6 mi 16 in Wilburton line; it does not state the 130 mi figure and may be a different or partial piece, so it is not cited. Start and end points are not stated by EIA (Oklahoma only); the name suggests west-to-east in Oklahoma. Not found: endpoints, county route, Oklahoma Corporation Commission filing. Existing row P0163 (Enable Oklahoma Instrastate Transmission, EOIT, system, 3540 km) has no expansion row; Transok is a predecessor operator, now Enable/Energy Transfer. Whether the 130 mi is already inside the P0163 length is unknown, so reviewer should check for overlap. Status operating is inferred from EIA Completed. Passes length rule (130 mi >= 15.5 mi). Route: no route, RouteType Unavailable pending a source. Medium tier: single source, endpoints missing. StartYear1 stands in for the in-service year (EIA 1997).
